name: smallfish
description: SmallFish local browser automation, page reading, web research, and on-demand page monitoring.

interface.shortDescription: Use a browser running on your computer.
interface.longDescription: Navigate and inspect websites, interact with pages, research public information, take screenshots, and check pages on demand. Browser profiles and sign-ins remain on the local computer.
defaultPrompt: Use SmallFish to open a website and summarize its visible content.
Use SmallFish to inspect this page and find a specific control without submitting anything.
